repoDetail.rejectDescription: Rejecting is permanent: the artifact stays blocked and cannot be released afterwards. The reason is stored on the artifact and recorded in the audit log.

repoSettings.policyExecuted: Policy executed: {count, plural, one {# artifact removed} other {# artifacts removed}}, {freed} freed
repoSettings.policyPreview: Preview: {count, plural, one {# artifact would be removed} other {# artifacts would be removed}} ({freed})
repoSettings.agePolicySaveFailed: Failed to save package age policy
repoSettings.ageGateSaveFailed: Failed to save age gate settings
repoSettings.keyChangedWarning: Changing the key will update all URLs for this repository. Existing client configurations will need to be updated.
repoSettings.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe the purpose of this repository...
repoSettings.publicAccessHint: Public repositories allow unauthenticated read access.
repoSettings.quotaHint: Maximum storage for this repository. Leave empty for no limit.
repoSettings.uploadSizeHint: Maximum size for a single artifact upload. This limit is set instance-wide by an administrator on the Settings page and applies to every repository.
repoSettings.versioningHint: Keep an immutable revision history for artifacts in this repository. Re-uploading a path with different content appends a new revision instead of overwriting; prior revisions stay downloadable from the artifact's Versions tab.
repoSettings.versioningToggleHint: Applies to future uploads. Turning this off stops recording new revisions; existing history remains addressable.
repoSettings.rpmWillRemove: Trusted key will be removed when you save.
repoSettings.debianHint: Proxy distro/component/architecture filters and Release-file metadata.
repoSettings.npmHint: Restrict which npm scopes and names resolve through this repository.
repoSettings.agePolicyHint: Hold freshly published packages in quarantine for a cooldown period after their release. New releases pulled from upstream are not served until the window passes, giving time to flag a compromised release before it reaches clients.
repoSettings.enableAgePolicyHint: Quarantine packages released within the cooldown window.
repoSettings.ageInvalid: Enter a cooldown period of at least one {unit}.
repoSettings.ageHint: Packages released less than this long ago are quarantined.
repoSettings.ageGateHint: Withhold upstream releases younger than a minimum age until they mature or an admin approves them from the age gate review queue.
repoSettings.enableAgeGateHint: Queue too-new releases for admin review instead of serving them to clients.
repoSettings.ageGateInvalid: Must be a whole number between {min} and {max}.
repoSettings.ageGateValidHint: Releases published fewer than this many days ago are withheld. 0 disables the age delay but keeps admin rejections enforced.
repoSettings.proxyCacheHint: How long the proxy keeps cached upstream artifacts before re-validating against upstream. Applies repository-wide; per-artifact eviction is available from the artifact details dialog.
repoSettings.cacheInvalid: Must be a whole number between {min} and {max}.
repoSettings.scanningHint: Vulnerability scanning and inline scan-and-block for this repository. When blocking is on, artifacts that violate the policy are actively prevented from being downloaded rather than only flagged after the fact.
repoSettings.enableScanningHint: Turn vulnerability scanning on for this repository.
repoSettings.scanOnUploadHint: Scan artifacts as they are published to this repository.
repoSettings.scanOnProxyHint: Scan upstream artifacts inline as they are proxied through this repository.
repoSettings.blockOnViolationHint: Actively block downloads of artifacts that violate the severity policy, instead of only recording a finding.
repoSettings.severityHint: Findings at or above this severity count as a policy violation.
repoSettings.failClosedHint: Fail closed: if the scanner is unavailable or an inline scan can't confirm the artifact is clean, the download is blocked. Security first — a proxy outage can interrupt availability.
repoSettings.failOpenHint: Fail open: if the scanner is unavailable or an inline scan can't confirm the artifact is clean, the download is served anyway. Availability first — an unscanned artifact can slip through.
repoSettings.failClosedDisabledHint: Enable scanning and "Scan on proxy download" to choose the fail-open / fail-closed behavior.
repoSettings.cleanupPoliciesHint: Lifecycle policies that automatically remove old or unused artifacts.
repoSettings.noPolicies: No cleanup policies configured for this repository.
repoSettings.noPoliciesHint: Cleanup policies can be created from the Lifecycle section in the administration panel.
repoSettings.pluginGenericHint: Custom layout provided by a WASM plugin (generic family)
repoSettings.deletePolicyDescription: Are you sure you want to delete the "{name}" policy? This will not affect any previously cleaned artifacts.

formatConfig.rpmDescription: ASCII-armored OpenPGP public key trusted to sign this RPM remote's repository metadata (repomd.xml). When set, curation sync verifies the upstream signature before ingesting. This is the proxy-verification trusted key, not a server-side signing key.
formatConfig.rpmExisting: A trusted key is configured. Entering a new key below replaces it.
formatConfig.proxyFiltersHint: Comma-separated allowlists for a Debian proxy. Leave empty (or use *) to proxy everything. Architecture-independent (all) packages are always permitted.
formatConfig.releaseMetadataHint: Optional fields written into generated Release files.
formatConfig.label: Label
formatConfig.allowedScopesHint: Comma or newline-separated @scope literals. Empty leaves the repository unrestricted by scope.
formatConfig.allowedPatternsHint: Additive glob patterns (*/?). A name is allowed if its scope is allowed OR any pattern matches.
formatConfig.allowUnscopedHint: Permit bare (non-@scope) package names to resolve.

pypiTracks.description: PyPI virtual repositories isolate locally-owned project names from the same name upstream by default (PEP 708, dependency-confusion mitigation). Declare a <track>tracks</track> relationship to re-union a local project's versions with a named upstream Simple index.
pypiTracks.emptyDetail: Locally-owned project names are fully isolated from upstream.
pypiTracks.confirmDescription: "{name}" will be isolated from upstream again. Unpinned installs will resolve only the local project's versions.

releaseTarget.description: Link this staging repository to a release repository. Promotions from here default to the linked target, and promotions elsewhere are rejected. The target must be a local repository using the same <format>{format}</format> format.
releaseTarget.notStagingDescription: Release-target promotion links artifacts from a staging repository to a release repository.
releaseTarget.notStaging: Release targets are only available for staging repositories. This repository is a {type} repository.

routingRules.title: Routing Rules
routingRules.description: Rewrite request paths before they are forwarded upstream. Each rule is a regex pattern and a rewrite template. Reference capture groups with <code1>$1</code1>, <code2>$2</code2>, and so on. Rules are evaluated in order; the first match wins.
routingRules.empty: No routing rules configured. Requests are forwarded upstream unchanged.
routingRules.bothRequired: Both pattern and rewrite target are required.
routingRules.invalidPattern: Path pattern is not a valid regular expression.
